criterion_scores.expected_or_correct: Residence time basis, reactor volume, and flow basis should be numerically consistent and non-contradictory, with clear distinction between nominal indices and physical channel contact time.
criterion_scores.rationale: The declared STP-based index formally closes, but the delivery contains major contradictory residence-time claims elsewhere (0.342679 min, ~1.025 min in-channel, and narrative claims of ~3–4 min). This does not make the topology impossible, but it materially degrades geometry/time interpretability and requires cleanup before execution.
criterion_scores.required_correction: Provide one consistent residence-time framework: clearly report the verified inlet/STP index from delivered flows and separately any measured or estimated in-channel holdup time, removing conflicting 3–4 min narrative claims.
